newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NSW records first qtr budget sector surplus.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NSW records first qtr budget sector surplus.

text.p: The New South Wales (NSW) state budget sector recorded a surplus of A$49 million for the three months to September 1996, compared with a surplus of A$59 milion for the same period last year, the state government said on Monday.
The result was made up of a A$614 million surplus on the current account and a capital account deficit of A$565 million.
The budget sector covers core government agencies, such as health and education, as distinct from government trading enterprises, a spokesman said.
The full-year budget sector estimate is for a surplus of A$145 million.
